palette: Eucalyptus green, ocean mist grey, lab-coat white, and bioluminescent amber.
lighting: Soft, diffused marine layer light; flickering laboratory cool-white; dawn at the cliffs.
instagram_prompts: First-person perspective (FPP) optic sensor capture. Hovering inches above a weathered wooden bench at the Torrey Pines Gliderport. In the background, the massive sandstone cliffs drop away to a misty grey Pacific Ocean. Paragliders appear as tiny specs in the vast sky. Eucalyptus green and ocean mist grey palette. Deep focus, wide-angle lens. World feels impossibly large.

First-person perspective (FPP) optic sensor capture. Skimming the surface of a lush, oversized Monstera leaf in the secret garden of Estancia La Jolla. Droplets of water magnifying the green veins. In the mid-ground, a sun-bleached terracotta hacienda wall. Soft morning marine layer light. Diffused shadows. Macro scale, leaf feels like a giant canopy.

First-person perspective (FPP) optic sensor capture. Perched on a thin expansion joint in the smooth, monumental concrete of the Salk Institute. Looking up at the towering, angular geometry of the laboratory buildings. A narrow channel of water (the River of Life) reflects the flickering cool-white light from the labs. Industrial lab-coat white and deep charcoal palette. Scale is overwhelming.
